text:
A food alley under Osaka's railway tracks. 🏮

It opened in 1950,
so former railway workers could earn a living.

Today about 200 tiny shops fill two floors.
One coffee shop has poured since 1968.
Most people walk straight past it.

Follow Japan by Station
for one Japan place a day.

#Osaka #Umeda #OsakaFood #JapanTravel #HiddenJapan
